notes.title: Version 1.0 will be released before Christmas
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39670270/d0ae01a168c3912e66f36e3e38e19521dc1aaa0c.png[/img]

The update will be released before Christmas instead of summer,

Sorry about that, turns out there's a lot of things I want to add to this version and I don't have the time before summer. Also with summer at our door I don't have the motivation. I prefer to wait and release something I am proud of instead of a rushed product.

If you are on our Discord I still come and check each day and read every message I have.

Here's a sneak peak
I love y'all ❤️

[i]- Santa Goat[/i]

notes.title: Bar & Maple Wine update
notes.notes:
Hello there!

There's a new bar location in town, maple wine and quality of life improvements like the tree cuttings acting like the seeds!
Hope you like it <3

[i]- Santa Goat[/i]

[h2]CHANGELOGS[/h2]

Bar open every nights with a slot machine!

notes.title: Championship Update
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Christmas fellow maple lords[/b]
Mon Bazou is now 3 year old, thank you for playing and hope you will like this one!
It was a very busy summer doing life! I will continue to work hard on the game so expect more update very soon :)

[i]- Santa Goat[/i]

[h2]CHAMPIONSHIP[/h2]

- Added a Car lift for sale

notes.title: Hot Hatch Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, fellow maple lords![/b]

Here's the long awaited Hot Hatch update!  I hope you like handbrake drifting, because that car is designed for it!
If you want more information about the next planned update, you can look at the road map in-game. The next big update will, hopefully, bring Mon Bazou out of Early Access to version 1.0!

Love you all!
---------------------------------------
[h2]Changelog[/h2]

HOT HATCH (Prinz)
- New unlockable project car
- Front wheel drive
- New engine / rims / transmission

STEERING WHEEL
- Better detection of the steering wheels
- Now working with Thrustmaster (Tested with T150)
- Better H-Shifter support
- Press keys or axis to bind instead of choosing in a list
- The force feedback has a better adjustment
- Added more keybinds (Every gear for H-Shifter, Handbrake, Lowbeam, Highbeam, Nitrous, Horn)

COOL, I GUESS
- Seven new languages: Czech, Danish, Dutch, Portuguese, Slovak, Slovenian, Swedish
- Added on Geforce Now
- [OlTruck] Blinker lights now working
- [OlTruck] Parking lights added in the instrument cluster
- Gilles can now find the big mapple syrup bed tank
- Added RPM in third person

BUGS
- Showing R and 0 km/h in third view
- [Konig] No collider each side of the trunk where the tail lights are situated
- [Konig] You can't rust a brand new hood
- [Konig] Original doors had holes in the side pocket

notes.title: Hot Hatch(Prinz) dev update & nominate Mon Bazou for this years Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow ditch riders!

I'm still working hard on the [b]Hot Hatch[/b] update, but it's now planned to release before Christmas! The car will be locked at the start of the game, but it will be unlockable by building up friendship. 

It has been such an amazing adventure doing this game... I quit my job early last year to pursue developing Mon Bazou full-time, and I'm looking forward to many more years of game development! The support from you all is amazing!

The reviews are still Overwhelmingly Positive after two years. This, and coming close on 10,000 reviews... TEN THOUSAND? Damn, that's a huge thing for me. 

Since a lot of people think the updates are too far apart, here's a little info:
- As a solo dev, I don't want to make false promises on a release date
- The main thing is, I want it to be like I imagined it to be
- Rushed updates are bad updates! Ahah!

If you haven't seen the road-map, here are the next things I will work on after the Hot Hatch update:
- A big, end-goal, weekend long multisport championship competition (Race, Drag, Off-road, etc.)
- Off-road racing track
- Fishing & activities on the islands

So, that's probably gonna be quite a good thing to send Mon Bazou out of early access!

I love you all,
-Santa Goat
